0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, 13th in the West) host the Denver Nuggets (1-1, 8th in the West, riding a one-game winning streak) in their fourth game of the season, with the Pelicans on a three-game losing streak and 0-1 at home. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain. New Orleans trails the season series 0-1 after a 141-135 loss in Denver on October 24, and it lost all three meetings in 2025-26.
